question: Do all six linked GEO, BioSample and SRA metadata records expose additional explicit biological-unit or technical-run keys?
decision: Document exact source cross-references and item-specific unit-field availability without certifying animal independence or resuming treatment analysis.
strongest_rival: Database sample/run identifiers, paired-end layout or SRA Pool membership are mistaken for animal identity, biological pairing or pooling.
discriminator: Join all six GEO titles and links to BioSample/SRA reverse references and run members, preserving explicit attributes and distinguishing technical records from animals.
exposure_record: All six raw BioSample/SRA metadata records were retrieved and their schemas, attributes and linked run accessions inspected before this freeze. Prior R1 and published outcomes remain exposed; no sequence or biological effect is analyzed.
biological_unit: Public metadata record; underlying source animal/preparation identity remains unknown unless explicitly deposited.
nesting_and_overlap: GEO, BioSample, SRA sample, experiment and run records refer to reused source material; database layers do not create replicates.
population_and_selection: All six GEO samples GSM4869228 through GSM4869233 and their exact linked BioSample/SRA records; no record selected by biological outcome.
contrast: Cross-database identity and source-field availability only; no biological contrast.
endpoint: Exact sample/experiment/run joins, source-reported attributes, candidate unit keys and technical sequencing layout.
methods: Standard-library SOFT and XML parsers; strict cross-reference and source-attribute checks; preserve per-record field inventories and source-access metadata.
missingness_and_exclusions: No samples excluded. Missing biological-unit fields remain unknown. Attribute-name screening is paired with documentary review of narrative fields.
multiplicity: No biological tests or significance calculations; deterministic metadata checks only.
precision_basis: No biological estimate or precision claim is computed.
interpretation_limit: Separate records/runs do not prove separate animals; sequencing PAIRED and Pool/Member are not biological pairing or animal-pooling evidence.
stop_rule: Reject duplicated records, incomplete six-sample coverage, contradictory cross-references or source attributes. No reads/sequences, inferred units or biological modeling.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective source-only extension; R1 remains immutable and biological execution holds remain unchanged.
